items.title: Beta 0.5.0 — music, widgets, game stats
items.body: Synced lyrics for almost any song, YouTube Music, a bigger music tab with seeking. Widgets can live on your desktop. Recording now starts on the whole screen with no picker, and games show FPS, CPU, GPU and RAM in a corner.

items.title: Pick how the island opens
items.body: Settings → Personalise → Opening animation: Morph, Unfold, Drop or Zoom.

items.title: Update alerts
items.body: The island now checks for updates every 30 minutes and sends a notification when a new version is out.
